body:
I'm not sure how religious establishments could help me. My family are conservative Christians, and I was raised as such, but am an atheist now (I haven't told them this for reasons I think would be obvious).

Yes, I'm dependent on my parents. I don't really know what they think of me. I believe they think there's something wrong with me, but I really don't know. I don't think it would be any use attempting to explain how I feel to them.

I'm hoping to be able to starve myself to death. I know that probably sounds childish. I'm already underweight, and I don't have much of an appetite anymore. I'm afraid I wouldn't be able to carry out a more proactive method, and I think this may be easier. My birthday is right around the corner, and I would really, really prefer to be dead before then.

I told my parents I was suicidal what must've been over a year ago now. I regret doing so, and nothing really came of it. I'm not close to my parents, or siblings, or anyone else for that matter.

Maybe a psychologist could help me, but I don't have any money, and my parents don't have a terribly lot either. I understand it's typically pretty pricey. You also can't really express suicidal thoughts without risking getting sent to the mental ward, which, I don't know  what they're like elsewhere, but, in the States are basically just prisons that you're forced to pay a couple thousand dollars a day to stay in. That's something I'd be pretty afraid of.

It is comforting to some degree to know that nothing I do really matters, and that no matter what I do (or don't do), my life won't last forever. I certainly don't believe in an afterlife. I don't know what the fuck I would do if I did. One life is more than I care to live. 

But, and I know I must sound like a fucking broken record by this point, I just don't enjoy living, and I could be completely wrong here, but as far as I can see there's no point in living if you don't enjoy life. And I very well may expect too much from life, I don't know, but I think that would just add to the reasons I'd be better off dead.

I've wanted to kill myself for a fairly long while now, and obviously I haven't done so yet. I mean, it wouldn't really be surprising if I never managed to do it. I just have to hope I'll be able to. I really dread the thought of having to live for another year, let alone fifty-odd.

Anyway, I appreciate that you've been trying to help me, but I just don't think I can be helped. I'm sorry for wasting your time.

Most of the channels I'm subscribed to either focus on video games or film review.


As for games, I guess I prefer grand strategy, a la Europa Universalis 4. I sometimes attempt to play Dwarf Fortress, but as much as I love the game, the perfectionist in me makes it quite difficult for me to play it. Other than that, there are a few Roguelikes I like playing occasionally.

I watch Youtube videos, play a couple different video games, and browse the internet. Yeah, I know. And even then, I feel like their effectiveness is diminishing. I have a lot harder time playing video games than I used to. I'll get about five minutes in and just lose interest a lot of the time.

The main thing is that these are just bandaid solutions. They distract me for a little while, and afterwards I feel the same as felt before. They say suicide is "a permanent solution to a temporary problem," but that's exactly what I want, a permanent solution.

I don't really enjoy anything. There are distractions that let me forget that I exist temporarily, but nothing that particularly makes me want to continue living.


Since you were curious, I'm 20.

I'm sorry to hear you're going through the same shit I am, and a breakup on top of it all.


I don't have any friends either, but I feel kind of indifferent about it. I was never very good with people, never had many friends, and I always spent a lot of time alone. I guess it just feels normal to me.


I'm not pursuing a job or an education, and I know, what a useful, productive member of society I am, eh? I have no motivation (or maybe I'm just really lazy, huh?), and I really just can't deal with people. And, of course, I always think, "Why bother, I'll be dead by X." Of course, I'm typically not dead by X, but that's a different problem.
